analysis.themes: A psychic girl is held in a New Age research institute by a doctor whose own transcendence curdled — plot is thin because the film is a sensory trap about institutional control.
analysis.atmosphere: Pure hypnagogic dread — synth drones and gel-lit corridors create an 80s that never existed, oppressive and beautiful.
analysis.narrative: The story is almost vestigial; watching it is the experience — slow pushes, saturated color, and ritual pacing demand surrender.
analysis.visual: One of the most committed retro-futurist aesthetics ever shot — every frame looks like a lost 1983 VHS box cover.
analysis.characters: Barry Nyle is repression curdled into madness; Elena is a consciousness escaping its own containment.
